conviction_note: Two small fuel-timing findings that point opposite ways on different lines (Q3 fuel roughly at the guide's basis, so the habitual beat survives; Q4 guide struck at a ~$106 spot Brent, deeper than the sell-side Q4 cuts imply) net to -0.5, and I shrink that to -0.2 because the skew pays for upside, the stock is -10% over 20 days and -34.6% off its high on exactly this fuel story, and both findings are macro-to-company inference rather than a company document.
bar: Q3 adjusted EPS ~$1.35 from the company's own June guide (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000815097/000081509726000086/a20262qearningsrelease8-k.htm), matched by consensus $1.35 (Alphastreet, https://news.alphastreet.com/carnival-corporation-ccl-q3-2026-preview-eps-est-1-35-reports-september-29/; BofA held Q3 at $1.35, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bank-america-cuts-carnival-stock-143700762.html) and Zacks $1.36; revenue consensus ~$8.36-8.39bn. FY guide $2.22; BofA Q4 $0.20 (cut from $0.27). Bar is sourced to the company guide plus agreeing estimates, so no cap applied.
positioning_check: Short interest 4.4% of float, up 35% over a month, cost to borrow 0.30%, availability far exceeds shares lent (ORTEX, 2026-09-26, https://ortex.news/articles/173483/analysts-cut-targets-as-ccl-short-interest-climbs-into-q3-print); sweep snippet 48.18m shares at 2026-09-15 settlement. Days to cover not published; computed ~2.1-2.7 days on the baseline's 22.6m avg daily volume. Not a crowded short. Skew -4.17 vol points (25d put IV below 25d call IV) = the option market pays for upside; put/call OI 0.58; ORTEX put/call ratio 1.10 vs 20d avg 1.24. Implied event move 6.64%.

findings.finding: Q3 (Jun-Aug) Brent averaged ~$87 (June $85, July $84, August $91 per EIA) against a June guide struck at spot fuel that management said moved EPS by less than $0.01 versus the March guide, which had assumed Brent $85 for Q3 — so the Q3 fuel headwind the previews cite is small, and Carnival's habitual beat of its own guide (Q2 beat March guidance by $100m) should carry Q3 EPS to roughly $1.38-1.42 against a $1.35 bar held at the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats of its own guide have been sold in 2026: Q2 (2026-06-23) beat $0.41 vs ~$0.33 and fell 4.87% (baseline) on the yield-guide cut; Q1 (March 2026) beat and 'shares dip' (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-carnival-corp-beats-q1-2026-forecasts-shares-dip-93CH-4585501). Only the Dec 2025 beat that came with a raise and a dividend reinstatement paid (+9.8%, https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/stock-market-today-dec-19-carnival-jumps-record-profits-and-dividend-reinstatement).
findings.why_not_priced: The wire frames fuel as 'Brent +34% since the Q2 report' (BofA, 2026-09-27), measured from the late-June trough (~$74) rather than from the fuel basis embedded in the Q3 guide; if the market had priced a Q3 beat, consensus would sit above the $1.35 guide rather than on it, as it usually does for a company that beats every quarter. Small size because a guide beat is exactly what this name's holders have sold twice this year, and because bunker prices do not map one-for-one onto Brent (Q2 fuel was $793/mt in a >$100 Brent quarter).
findings.independence: Mechanism and guide-basis come from the company's 8-K and the Q2 call transcript (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-carnival-beats-q2-2026-estimates-but-shares-fall-93CH-4756020: guidance 'on the current spot price of fuel', impact 'less than $0.01 per share versus prior guidance'); March basis from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/815097/000081509726000034/a20261qearningsrelease8-k.htm. Demand corroboration from peers after Carnival last spoke: RCL Q2 (2026-07-28) beat on close-in demand and raised FY (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/884887/000088488726000036/a2026q2earningsrelease.htm); Viking Q2 (2026-08-19) beat with 2027 bookings +21% (https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/viking-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-2026-08-19). Shares the fuel-basis premise with finding 2.

findings.finding: The Q4/FY guide will be struck at spot fuel with Brent at ~$106 on 2026-09-28 against a June basis equivalent to ~$80 Brent for Q4 (March assumption, unchanged in June to within $0.01), a ~30%+ rise that on the company's own sensitivity (~$46m of Q4 net income per 10%, derived from $102m remainder-of-year less $56m Q3) is ~$0.10-0.13 of Q4 EPS — deeper than the $0.07 Q4 cut BofA made (to $0.20), so the Q4 guide risks printing below the Street's Q4 number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide is the line this stock trades on: June 2026 beat on EPS and fell 4.87% (baseline) / -5.75% premarket on the yield-guide cut to 2.25% from 3.25%; Dec 2025 raised outlook +9.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partially: every preview says fuel, and the stock is -15% in a month and at a 16-month low on it. The residual is mechanical — Carnival guides at spot, not the backwardated curve (EIA 2H26 ~$90), and spot is at a local high on the eve of the print; BofA's $0.07 Q4 cut is roughly a 15% fuel move on the sensitivity, not 30%. If the market had priced a spot-fuel guide, Q4 estimates would sit nearer $0.13-0.15 than $0.20 and the option market would not be paying up for calls.
findings.independence: Same company 8-K and transcript as finding 1 for the basis; Brent level from CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/28/oil-price-today-wti-brent-trump-iran.html) and the EIA STEO. Offsets the fundamental read would need to overcome: EUR/USD guided near its 2026 low (1.1325 on 2026-06-24) and ~1.14-1.15 since, a small FX tailwind; yield upside from close-in demand. Not contradictory with finding 1: different quarter, same premise.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR 8-Ks since June: only the 2026-08-05 redemption of $500m 7% 2029 notes at 103.5 after the collateral release on a second investment-grade rating (2026-06-25) — financing that cuts interest, below the line and already public; not a finding (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/815097/000095014226002267/eh260815320_8k.htm)

Q2 10-Q (filed ~2026-06-19): no fuel hedging, $390m repurchased in Q2, no Middle East contingency language, nothing new in subsequent events (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000815097/000081509726000096/ccl-20260531.htm)

Weather: Hurricane Polo and a nor'easter altered a handful of late-September itineraries (Panorama, Sunshine) — Q4, immaterial (https://cruiseindustrynews.com/cruise-news/2026/09/hurricane-polo-carnival-panorama-to-sail-revised-itinerary/)
Carnival Cruise Line newsroom September 2026: marketing and itinerary items only (https://www.carnival-news.com/)
Bunker price series (Ship & Bunker, OilPriceAPI): pages undated or served inconsistent years; not usable as dated evidence

NCLH Q2 (2026-07-30) cut FY on fuel and its own brand missteps — company-specific, already in the price (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/30/3335864/24500/en/Norwegian-Cruise-Line-Holdings-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results.html)
baseline_tension: Finding 2 leans against the skew (upside paid, -4.17) and the heavy 20-day run-down that already prices the fuel story, and finding 1 agrees with the skew but lands on a line this name has sold twice this year; net the price already carries nearly all of this, so the emitted number is well inside the sum.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (fact is not reaction): Q3 beat finding cut from +0.8 to +0.3 because 2026's two guide beats were sold (Q2 -4.87%, Q1 dip).

Lesson 5 (macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis): both findings rest on Brent-to-bunker mapping, not a company fuel number; Q4 guide finding cut from -1.5 to -0.8 and print_vs_bar trimmed from +3.0 to +2.5.
Lesson 7 (sign against skew): the negative guide finding runs against an upside-paid skew with a non-crowded 4.4% short; kept small and stated why rather than dropped.
Lesson 3 (caveat reaches the number): emitted -0.2 against a findings sum of -0.5, because baseline_tension says the run-down already prices the fuel story.
Lesson 6: bar sourced to the company guide plus agreeing estimates, both findings resolve 2026-09-29; left standing.
